# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

[ Read more ][207]
Innovation

## Scientific innovation at work

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

[ Read more ][208]

## Get to know us

Our history

We trace our roots back to 1909 when Dr. Josep Antoni Grifols i Roig founded a clinical analysis
laboratory in Barcelona, the precursor to Laboratorios Grifols.

Grifols' mission, to improve people's health and well-being, has patients, donors and society at the

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is

who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

## Featured products

## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

[ Learn more ][141]
[ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader - Semi-Automated Blood Bank Analyzer]

## LYRA^{™} Assays

Optimize your lab's workflow with QuidelOrtho LYRA^{™} real-time PCR assays, an open platform
solution for high-quality molecular testing.

[ Learn more ][142]
[LYRA™ Assays]

## QUICKVUE^{™} Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests

QUICKVUE^{™} rapid lateral-flow tests produce accurate results in minutes, allowing for faster
diagnoses, better-informed treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[ Learn more ][143]
[QUICKVUE™ Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests]

## TRIAGE^{™} System

QUIDEL^{™} TRIAGE^{™} System provides a reliable solution at the point-of-care for quick and easy
lab quality diagnostic results for a variety of immunoassays.

[ Learn more ][144]
[Triage® System]

## ORTHO VISION^{™} Swift Automated Immunohematology System

For dependably accurate and secure results, ORTHO VISION™ Swift and ORTHO VISION Swift Max analyzers
provide enhanced processing power, responsiveness and data security.

[ Learn more ][145]
[ORTHO VISION™ Swift Automated Immunohematology System]

## NULEXA^{™} System

The NULEXA^{™} System is an ultra-rapid real-time PCR molecular testing system that is designed to
deliver highly sensitive, multiplex testing for influenza A/B and COVID-19 directly from a swab
sample, in ten minutes or less.

[ Learn more ][146]
[NULEXA<sup>™</sup> System]

## Featured products

## Featured products

## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

[ Learn more ][141]
[ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader - Semi-Automated Blood Bank Analyzer]

## LYRA^{™} Assays

Optimize your lab's workflow with QuidelOrtho LYRA^{™} real-time PCR assays, an open platform
solution for high-quality molecular testing.

[ Learn more ][142]
[LYRA™ Assays]

## QUICKVUE^{™} Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests

QUICKVUE^{™} rapid lateral-flow tests produce accurate results in minutes, allowing for faster
diagnoses, better-informed treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[ Learn more ][143]
[QUICKVUE™ Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests]

## TRIAGE^{™} System

QUIDEL^{™} TRIAGE^{™} System provides a reliable solution at the point-of-care for quick and easy
lab quality diagnostic results for a variety of immunoassays.

[ Learn more ][144]
[Triage® System]

## ORTHO VISION^{™} Swift Automated Immunohematology System

For dependably accurate and secure results, ORTHO VISION™ Swift and ORTHO VISION Swift Max analyzers
provide enhanced processing power, responsiveness and data security.

[ Learn more ][145]
[ORTHO VISION™ Swift Automated Immunohematology System]

## NULEXA^{™} System

The NULEXA^{™} System is an ultra-rapid real-time PCR molecular testing system that is designed to
deliver highly sensitive, multiplex testing for influenza A/B and COVID-19 directly from a swab
sample, in ten minutes or less.

[ Learn more ][146]
[NULEXA<sup>™</sup> System]

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## About Ampath


### AMPATH: Best Diagnostic Centre & Pathology Lab in India

AMPATH (American Institute of Pathology and Laboratory Sciences Pvt. Ltd.) is proud to be recognized
as the Best Pathology Lab and Diagnostic Centre in India. Our mission is to deliver reliable,
accurate, and timely diagnostic results that are essential for informed healthcare decisions. With
over 2600 specialized tests, including clinical biochemistry, microbiology, and histopathology,
AMPATH stands at the forefront of pathology and laboratory sciences. We are dedicated to offering
the most accurate services in the shortest possible time, ensuring a swift and smooth experience for
our customers.

Our network includes the Central Reference Laboratory in Hyderabad, supported by 22+ satellite labs
across the country. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of excellence, leveraging
advanced technology and innovative quality management systems. This ensures consistent reliability
and accuracy in all our testing processes, demonstrating our dedication to quality across all
operations.

AMPATH is not just a diagnostic service provider; we are an integral part of the communities we
serve. Our customer-centric approach ensures that our clients receive exceptional care, from a
comfortable phlebotomy experience to professional guidance and support throughout the diagnosis
process. Every test and every report are handled with the utmost attention to accuracy and quality,
empowering our clients to make timely and effective healthcare choices.

Our vision is to become a global network of highly automated, sophisticated labs that are synonymous
with cutting-edge technology, unwavering reliability, and stringent ethical practices. As the Best
Diagnostic Centre in India, we are poised to expand our footprint, always driven by our mission to
make a difference in the well-being of every patient we serve.

secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports.

* 40 years of legacy in the healthcare industry

# Advocacy for People Living with Diabetes

Diabetes is the most expensive chronic condition in the U.S. and affects millions of families. This
Chronic Disease Awareness Month, help us continue advocating for people living with diabetes.

[ Donate Today ][150] [  Learn more ][151]

## It All Matters

We’ve learned in our 85 years that in the fight to end diabetes, everything matters. So this month,
we’re recognizing all those getting up alongside us and staying in the fight to end diabetes.

[play video]

## What's Happening?

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy
living resources, and more!

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan
legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

Understanding your risk and taking early action are key steps for diabetes prevention. Explore

# D-Dimer FS

## Emergency test for exclusion of thrombotic events

# Clinical relevance

During plasma coagulation soluble fibrin is generated. By degradation of cross-linked fibrin,
characteristic products called D-dimers are released. Increased D-dimer levels indicate the
activation of coagulation and fibrinolysis processes.** Low levels of D-dimer are mainly** **used
**to **exclude **venous thromboembolism (VTE) such as deep vein thrombosis of the leg (DVT) and
pulmonary embolism (PE).

## Why Choose Us?

At Ganesh diagnostic, we offer multiple services to our patients at affordable prices because your
health is our first priority. We have a skillful and talented team associated with us to deliver the
best to our clients.

A free 24/7 ambulance service is also available to avoid havoc in emergency situations. We have
updated technologies to generate **100% accurate reports** for every test and check-up. We are an
organization that has been trusted by 30,000+ doctors. Active in the business for quite some time.

Back in 2001, famed radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma laid the foundations of this organization after his
father, Ganesh Chand Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a
significant ride of many things. Today, we are considered one of the **best diagnostic centres and
[pathology][116] labs across Delhi**, robust problem solvers, and highly efficient in all areas.

## About Ganesh Diagnostic

**Ganesh Diagnostic** and Imaging Centre Pvt. Ltd. has been active in the **Diagnostic and
Pathology** Service sector for quite some time, Back in 2001, Famed Radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma
laid the foundation of this organization with his father, Renowned Radiologist, Dr. Ganesh Chandra
Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a significant ride of many
things. Now, we are seen as one of the **Best Diagnostic and Pathology** services providers around
**Delhi**, resolving issues and problems in a robust and highly effective way all across the
board. At our Delhi-based diagnostic centres, we provide an array of services including *[blood
tests][117], [X-rays][118], [ultrasounds][119], [CT scans][120], [MRI scans][121]*, etc. We also
offer *[home sample collection in Delhi][122]* and help identify diseases early so that treatment as
soon as possible.

## Why Choose Us?

At Ganesh diagnostic, we offer multiple services to our patients at affordable prices because your
health is our first priority. We have a skillful and talented team associated with us to deliver the
best to our clients.

A free 24/7 ambulance service is also available to avoid havoc in emergency situations. We have
updated technologies to generate **100% accurate reports** for every test and check-up. We are an
organization that has been trusted by 30,000+ doctors. Active in the business for quite some time.

Back in 2001, famed radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma laid the foundations of this organization after his
father, Ganesh Chand Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a
significant ride of many things. Today, we are considered one of the **best diagnostic centres and
[pathology][116] labs across Delhi**, robust problem solvers, and highly efficient in all areas.

## About Ganesh Diagnostic

**Ganesh Diagnostic** and Imaging Centre Pvt. Ltd. has been active in the **Diagnostic and
Pathology** Service sector for quite some time, Back in 2001, Famed Radiologist Dr. Ravin Sharma
laid the foundation of this organization with his father, Renowned Radiologist, Dr. Ganesh Chandra
Sharma. From humble beginnings, our growth and expansion have become a significant ride of many
things. Now, we are seen as one of the **Best Diagnostic and Pathology** services providers around
**Delhi**, resolving issues and problems in a robust and highly effective way all across the
board. At our Delhi-based diagnostic centres, we provide an array of services including *[blood
tests][117], [X-rays][118], [ultrasounds][119], [CT scans][120], [MRI scans][121]*, etc. We also
offer *[home sample collection in Delhi][122]* and help identify diseases early so that treatment as
soon as possible.

[Learn More][150] * Exhibition | *13* April 2026 [CMEF 2026 On-site Report | Getein Empowers the Diagnostic World][151] CMEF 2026 On-site Report | Getein Empowers the Diagnostic World      The 2026 China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF) is underway at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai). Since opening day, Getein's booth (Booth No. 7.1P27) has been drawing significant crowds, establishing itself as one of the most talked-about exhibits in the diagnostic hall. Booth Highlights The Getein team is warmly welcoming partners from China and overseas to visit our booth. In-depth discussions, ranging from precision diagnostic needs to total solution planning, are making the path to future cooperation increasingly clear.     As a key platform connecting the global medical device market, this year's CMEF (April 9–12 2026) brings together industry elites from around the world. Getein's booth with its innovative diagnostic concepts and cutting-edge technology displays is attracting a steady stream of professional visitors.     Spotlight At the exhibition, Getein's innovative products successfully drew lots of partners and industry professionals from home and abroad. The diagnostic solution comprehensively covers POCT, chemiluminescence, clinical chemistry, modular systems, hematology, coagulation, molecular diagnostics, veterinary diagnostics and rehabilitation products. It jointly builds a full-scenario and intelligent diagnostic ecosystem from fast point-of-care tests to high-throughput laboratory solutions.     Event Information ·Event Name: 2026 China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF) ·Date: April 9–12, 2026 ·Venue: National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai) ·Getein Booth No.: 7.1P27     Looking Ahead The exhibition is in full swing. Getein sincerely invites more industry colleagues and partners to visit Booth 7.1P27 and experience the innovative appeal of our smart lab solutions firsthand. We look forward to meeting, talking, and co-creating with even more friends during the remaining days of the show.           [[CMEF 2026 On-site Report | Getein Empowers the Diagnostic World]][152] * Exhibition | *26* March 2026 [Fully Self-developed Lineup Shines in Xiamen, Promotions Ignite CACLP 2026][153] Fully Self-developed Lineup Shines in Xiamen, Promotions Ignite CACLP 2026 The 23rd CACLP officially kicks off today in Xiamen. Making a powerful statement with the theme "Fully Self-developed, One-stop Solution", Getein Biotech unveils its star-studded product lineup, showcasing a complete ecosystem ranging from POCT to fully automated laboratory lines. Getein's booth consistently pulls in a steady stream of visitors.   The Center of Attention As Getein Biotech's newest innovation in laboratory automation, the Metis 7000 has built a strong industry reputation for its highly integrated design, reliable performance, and intelligent workflow management. Metis 7000 is also drawing considerable crowds at the exhibition, with many attendees stopping by for a closer look.     The first day of CACLP is off to an extraordinary start for Getein. Our booth has become a true hub of international energy, welcoming distributors from across the globe. With every handshake and meaningful conversation, we are witnessing something truly special: a powerful vote of confidence in our products. These partners are not just exploring solutions; they are placing their trust in the Getein brand. Their enthusiasm speaks volumes, reaffirming that our commitment to quality, innovation, and reliable diagnostics resonates deeply on a global scale.     New Product Launch Beyond the standout performance of its star automated line, Getein Biotech's two new products unveiled this time—the CM-480 Benchtop Fully Automated Clinical Chemistry Analyzer and the MAGICL 6800 Fully Automated Chemiluminescence Immunoassay Analyzer—also become focal points of the booth, drawing large crowds of professional visitors to stop and explore.      The Road Ahead     Looking ahead, Getein will remain committed to innovation, deepen its presence in the in-vitro diagnostics field, and launch even more competitive products and services to drive high-quality development in laboratory medicine.     [[Fully Self-developed Lineup Shines in Xiamen, Promotions Ignite CACLP 2026]][154] * Exhibition | *13* February 2026 [Getein Concludes a Successful Journey at WHX Labs Dubai!][155] Getein Concludes a Successful Journey at WHX Labs Dubai!   The Event Concludes, the Future Begins The WHX Labs Dubai exhibition has come to a successful close, marking a journey filled with inspiration and meaningful connections. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to every visitor, partner, and friend who stopped by Booth S1.B50.     Over the past few days, our booth buzzed with vibrant and professional exchanges. We engaged in in-depth and fruitful discussions with industry peers, partners, and friends from the Middle East and around the world, exploring regional challenges and opportunities. Together, we envisioned the future blueprint of precision diagnostics and smart laboratories, with every insightful conversation leaving us enriched and inspired.     Getein’s Booth: A Focal Point in the Middle East As a pivotal hub connecting Eastern and Western laboratory markets, WHX Labs Dubai gathered global industry attention. Getein’s booth, with its innovative diagnostic concepts and cutting-edge technological displays, attracted a steady stream of professional visitors, fostering an atmosphere of continuous engagement and dialogue.     Our team, with professionalism and enthusiasm, warmly welcomed numerous new and existing friends from Gulf Cooperation Council countries, North Africa, South Asia, and Europe.

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

## Built for the team, open to your agents

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

#### 1M+

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

  Hipro assists more than 1,000 clinics to conduct departmental tests every year. Most of the
  pediatric emergencies in these clinics are fever and infection. There used to occur situations
  where children have to wait for a long time from billing to test results, which generally costs

[ Why Choose Hipro ][122]

Hipro Biotechnology Corp, founded on September 29th, 2006, is a high-tech enterprise based on
international advanced medical technologies and brilliant self-innovations to provide first-class
products all over the world. Hipro focuses on R&D, manufacturing, marketing, and relevant services
of Point-of-Care products. The head-office is located in Hebei Province, with a world-class
high-capacity manufacturing facility (10,000 sq.m. ) and equipped with fully automated assembly line
GMP standardized production workshop.Hipro, with her reagent R&D Center at Silicon Valley, USA and
instrument R&D Center at Freiburg, Germany. Hipro has set up subsidiaries in Beijing, Suzhou,
Chengdu, Guangzhou, etc.,  and also built a new industrial base for microfluidic chips in China
Medical City, Taizhou, Jiangsu Province (53.3 acres). Hipro adheres to the core values of
simplicity, integrity, diligence, and excellence. Hipro's continuous strive for a better design of
in vitro diagnostic solutions has ensured the user a simpler operational experience, faster and

  ## Troponin I Test
  
  About Troponin I TestThe Troponin I Test is a blood test that detects Troponin I, a protein
  released into the bloodstream when the heart muscle is damaged. It is primarily used to diagnose
  heart attacks and other cardiac conditions. Even small elevations in Troponin I levels can
  indicate heart damage, making it a critical test for people with chest pain, shortness of breath,
  or irregular heartbeats.Preparations Before Troponin I TestNo fasting is required for the
  test.Avoid strenuous physical activity before the test, as it may increase Troponin I
  levels.Inform your doctor about any medications you are taking, especially those related to heart
  conditions or blood thinners.Stay hydrated and follow any additional instructions provided by your
  healthcare provider.What to Expect During the ProcedureA healthcare professional will clean the
  area (usually the arm) with an antiseptic.A small needle will be inserted into a vein to draw a
  blood sample.The sample is collected in a vial and sent to the laboratory for testing.The entire
  process takes just a few minutes, and results are usually available within a few hours to a
  day.Why Doctors Recommend Troponin I TestDoctors recommend the Troponin I Test to:Detect Heart
  Attacks: A high Troponin I level confirms myocardial infarction (heart attack).Evaluate Chest
  Pain: Helps determine if chest pain is related to heart disease or another cause.Monitor Heart
  Conditions: Used to track heart damage in people with heart failure, myocarditis, or
  pericarditis.Assess Effectiveness of Treatment: Checks if treatments for heart attack or cardiac
  issues are working.Factors That Contribute to the Risk of Elevated Troponin I LevelsSeveral
  conditions and lifestyle factors can cause high Troponin I levels, including:Heart Attack
  (Myocardial Infarction) – The most common cause of elevated Troponin I.Heart Failure – Weak heart
  muscles can release troponins into the blood.Inflammation (Myocarditis, Pericarditis) – Swelling
  of the heart tissue.Severe High Blood Pressure – Can put extra strain on the heart.Kidney Disease
  – Reduces the body’s ability to clear Troponin I from the blood.Intense Physical Exercise –
  Strenuous workouts can temporarily raise troponin levels.Sepsis or Severe Infections – Can cause
  heart damage and increased troponins.Understanding the Test ResultsNormal Troponin I Levels:
  Generally less than 0.04 ng/mL (varies by lab).Slightly Elevated Troponin I Levels: Could indicate
  mild heart stress, kidney disease, or inflammation.Significantly High Troponin I Levels: Suggests
  a heart attack or serious heart damage.Doctors interpret results along with ECG, symptoms, and
  medical history to provide a final diagnosis.What are the Benefits of the Troponin I Test?Early
  Detection of Heart Attacks – Helps in quick diagnosis and emergency treatment.Accurate Monitoring
  – Tracks heart muscle damage after a cardiac event.Non-Invasive & Quick – A simple blood test
  with fast results.Helps in Risk Assessment – Identifies individuals at high risk for heart
  disease.How to Maintain Healthy Troponin I LevelsAdopt a Heart-Healthy Diet – Eat foods rich in
  omega-3s, fiber, and antioxidants.Exercise Regularly – Engage in moderate physical activity like
  walking or cycling.Manage Blood Pressure & Cholesterol – Keep them in a healthy range.Avoid
  Smoking & Excess Alcohol – Both increase the risk of heart disease.Regular Checkups – Get
  routine heart health screenings to monitor risk factors.

  ## Troponin I Test
  
  About Troponin I TestThe Troponin I Test is a blood test that detects Troponin I, a protein
  released into the bloodstream when the heart muscle is damaged. It is primarily used to diagnose
  heart attacks and other cardiac conditions. Even small elevations in Troponin I levels can
  indicate heart damage, making it a critical test for people with chest pain, shortness of breath,
  or irregular heartbeats.Preparations Before Troponin I TestNo fasting is required for the
  test.Avoid strenuous physical activity before the test, as it may increase Troponin I
  levels.Inform your doctor about any medications you are taking, especially those related to heart
  conditions or blood thinners.Stay hydrated and follow any additional instructions provided by your
  healthcare provider.What to Expect During the ProcedureA healthcare professional will clean the
  area (usually the arm) with an antiseptic.A small needle will be inserted into a vein to draw a
  blood sample.The sample is collected in a vial and sent to the laboratory for testing.The entire
  process takes just a few minutes, and results are usually available within a few hours to a
  day.Why Doctors Recommend Troponin I TestDoctors recommend the Troponin I Test to:Detect Heart
  Attacks: A high Troponin I level confirms myocardial infarction (heart attack).Evaluate Chest
  Pain: Helps determine if chest pain is related to heart disease or another cause.Monitor Heart
  Conditions: Used to track heart damage in people with heart failure, myocarditis, or
  pericarditis.Assess Effectiveness of Treatment: Checks if treatments for heart attack or cardiac
  issues are working.Factors That Contribute to the Risk of Elevated Troponin I LevelsSeveral
  conditions and lifestyle factors can cause high Troponin I levels, including:Heart Attack
  (Myocardial Infarction) – The most common cause of elevated Troponin I.Heart Failure – Weak heart
  muscles can release troponins into the blood.Inflammation (Myocarditis, Pericarditis) – Swelling
  of the heart tissue.Severe High Blood Pressure – Can put extra strain on the heart.Kidney Disease
  – Reduces the body’s ability to clear Troponin I from the blood.Intense Physical Exercise –
  Strenuous workouts can temporarily raise troponin levels.Sepsis or Severe Infections – Can cause
  heart damage and increased troponins.Understanding the Test ResultsNormal Troponin I Levels:
  Generally less than 0.04 ng/mL (varies by lab).Slightly Elevated Troponin I Levels: Could indicate
  mild heart stress, kidney disease, or inflammation.Significantly High Troponin I Levels: Suggests
  a heart attack or serious heart damage.Doctors interpret results along with ECG, symptoms, and
  medical history to provide a final diagnosis.What are the Benefits of the Troponin I Test?Early
  Detection of Heart Attacks – Helps in quick diagnosis and emergency treatment.Accurate Monitoring
  – Tracks heart muscle damage after a cardiac event.Non-Invasive & Quick – A simple blood test
  with fast results.Helps in Risk Assessment – Identifies individuals at high risk for heart

Maurya Labs was setup in the year 1998 by Dr A.K.Sinha in the city of Purnia. In the year 2004

Maurya Labs has always been in the forefront of bringing the latest and most advanced technology in
the country in the field of Pathology. All our machines are closed systems delivering highly
accurate reports. Maurya Labs got NABL accreditation in the year 2012. In the last 26 years Maurya
Labs has earned the trust of doctors and patients for the timely delivery of test results and the
reliability of these results.

more than 25 collection centres across Bihar. The logistics for sample movement are managed in such
a manner that we can delivery same day results for most of the tests anywhere in the country.

# WELCOME TO MAURYA LABS

# ABOUT

Maurya Labs was setup in the year 1998 by Dr A.K.Sinha in the city of Purnia. In the year 2004
Maurya Labs got the first 3 part hemoanalyzer and in 2007 the first fully automatic Biochemistry
Analyzer. Today Maurya Labs uses only 5 part fully automatic hemoanalyzers at all its labs. Dr
Anurag Mohan joined Maurya Labs in the year 2014 and is the main driving force in the deployment of
digital technology at the Lab.

 

# QUALITY

Maurya Labs has always been in the forefront of bringing the latest and most advanced technology in
the country in the field of Pathology. All our machines are closed systems delivering highly
accurate reports. Maurya Labs got NABL accreditation in the year 2012. In the last 26 years Maurya
Labs has earned the trust of doctors and patients for the timely delivery of test results and the
reliability of these results.

 

# NETWORK

Maurya Labs is now present in Purnia, Katihar, Araria and Madhepura. Maurya Labs provides pathology
services at multiple hospitals across the country by establishing a lab within the hospital. We have
more than 25 collection centres across Bihar. The logistics for sample movement are managed in such
a manner that we can delivery same day results for most of the tests anywhere in the country.

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,

# Understand your lab tests, understand your health

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

Testing.com is supported by readers and we may also earn commissions through products purchased
using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

[ Show all tests ][51]
[Home Page Banner Image]

## How it Works

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

[View Testing Guides][52]
[How it Works Image 1]

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

[How it Works Image 2]

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

[View Resources][53]

### Explore your treatment options

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

[View Treatments][54]

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

[Learn More][92]

## Latest News

May 16, 2022

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

[bacteria]
**Antibiotic Resistance in Bacteria**

Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria are able to survive and grow in the presence of one or more
antibiotics.

# Understand your lab tests, understand your health

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

Testing.com is supported by readers and we may also earn commissions through products purchased
using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

[ Show all tests ][51]
[Home Page Banner Image]

## How it Works

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

[View Testing Guides][52]
[How it Works Image 1]

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

[How it Works Image 2]

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

[View Resources][53]

### Explore your treatment options

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

[View Treatments][54]

Blood tests examine and measure different components of the blood. Blood testing is one of the most
common methods of medical testing, used to provide important information about countless aspects of
health.

STD tests are used to screen for and diagnose specific sexually transmitted diseases.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

[Learn More][92]

## Latest News

May 16, 2022

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

[bacteria]
**Antibiotic Resistance in Bacteria**

Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria are able to survive and grow in the presence of one or more
antibiotics.

## Your health, on your time

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.
* Manage your appointments
* View your test results
* Send messages to your doctor
* Request medication refills
* Pay your bill

[ Sign in or Sign Up ][26] [ What is MyUFHealth? ][27]
[Smart phone with MyUFHealth open in the browser app]

## Excellent care,
## close to home

With locations all over Florida, you'll find convenient care for you and your family.
* 140 Primary Care & Specialty Practices
* 2k Health Care Providers
* 26 Emergency & Urgent Care Locations
* 5 Dental
  Locations
* 12 Hospitals

[ View All Locations ][28]

## Leading the way to
## better health care

Nationally ranked among the best

[ About Our Rankings ][29]
[U.S. News & World Report: Best Hospitals (Ranked in 7 specialties) and Best Children's Hospitals
(Ranked in 6 specialties)]

## Get the right care,
## when you need it
* ### Primary Care
  
  Choose from our network of highly skilled doctors and providers for your regular care.
  
  [ Find Adult Primary Care ][30] [ Find Pediatric Primary Care ][31]
* ### Specialty Care
  
  Our experts are here to treat your unique medical and surgical needs.
  
  [ Find Adult Specialty Care ][32] [ Find Pediatric Specialty Care ][33]
* ### Urgent Care
  
  Visit Urgent Care when you can't wait to be seen by your primary care provider.
  
  [ Find Urgent Care ][34]
* ### Emergency Care
  
  Our ER and trauma centers are available 24/7 for when you need immediate help.
  
  [ Find Emergency Care ][35]
* ### Dental Care
  
  We offer a complete range of dental and oral health care for adults and children.
  
  [ Find a Dentist ][36]
* ### Veterinary Care
  
  Find ongoing and emergency care for animals of all species.
  
  [ Find a Vet ][37]

[U.S. Olympics & Paralympics Medical Network Logo]

We’re proud to be a National Medical Center for the **U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Medical Network**,
providing Team USA’s elite athletes with the same world-class health care that’s available to you
and your family.

[ Our Collaboration ][38] [ Amazing Athletes ][39]
[Erin Jackson, ice skating on a rink in a black team USA suit and white skates]

## Improving health and lives through research

We are a top-tier research university. We focus on groundbreaking research that improves public
health every day.

[ Our Research ][40]

## Training tomorrow’s health care providers

Our academic health center is the largest in the Southeast. We educate the next generation of
healers, discoverers and inventors.

[ Our Colleges ][41]

## medicine forward

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

## Trust Vijaya for Advanced Medical Care

Whether you are looking for a [radiology centre][143] or pathology tests, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre
is the first and ultimate choice. Our vision and reputation have made us the leading name in the
medical sector.

As one of the best [diagnostic centres][144], Vijaya offers world-class support and advanced care,
which can help clinicians diagnose the exact medical issue you are experiencing.

Get in touch with us for the best diagnostic support delivered with professionalism, care, and
empathy.

For any enquiries or more information, Call Us Today!

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

## Trust Vijaya for Advanced Medical Care

Whether you are looking for a [radiology centre][143] or pathology tests, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre
is the first and ultimate choice. Our vision and reputation have made us the leading name in the
medical sector.

As one of the best [diagnostic centres][144], Vijaya offers world-class support and advanced care,
which can help clinicians diagnose the exact medical issue you are experiencing.

Get in touch with us for the best diagnostic support delivered with professionalism, care, and
empathy.

For any enquiries or more information, Call Us Today!

What other lab results and documents Wizey breaks down 48 examples · 6 categories

### Medical documents
* **MRI report**Explains the terms and key findings in your text MRI report
* **CT report**Breaks down the conclusions, areas of attention and radiologist's wording
* **ECG report**Explains rhythm, intervals and terms from the existing description
* **Ultrasound report**Breaks down organ sizes, structure, conclusions and recommendations
* **Hospital discharge summary**A clear explanation of the diagnosis, tests, prescriptions and
  follow-up steps
* **Doctor's report**Turns medical language into a plain plan of questions and next steps
* **Prescriptions**Breaks down the regimen, the goal of each item and what to clarify with your
  doctor
* **Visit note**Structures complaints, examination findings, conclusions and recommendations
* **Test results**Cross-references text reports with lab values when they're uploaded together

### Blood tests
* **Complete blood count (CBC)**Assess overall health and a wide range of disorders
* **Comprehensive metabolic panel**Assess kidney and liver function, electrolyte and fluid balance
* **Lipid profile**Cholesterol levels to assess cardiovascular health
* **Thyroid function**TSH, T3, T4 — assessing the thyroid hormone profile
* **Hemoglobin A1c**A long-term measure of blood glucose in diabetes
* **Liver function**ALT, AST, bilirubin — markers related to liver health
* **PSA**Prostate health screening
* **C-reactive protein (CRP)**A marker of inflammatory activity in the body
* **Ferritin**Checking your body's iron stores

### Hormone tests
* **Testosterone**Reproductive and overall health in men and women
* **Estrogen**Assessing reproductive health in women
* **Progesterone**Fertility, pregnancy and cycle balance
* **Cortisol**The stress hormone and adrenal function
* **Insulin**Insulin production and diabetes control
* **Growth hormone**Tissue development and metabolism
* **DHEA-S**Assessing adrenal function
* **TSH**Regulation of thyroid hormones
* **LH / FSH**Reproductive hormone balance

### Urine tests
* **Urinalysis**Screening for metabolic and kidney disorders and infections
* **Microalbumin**Early signs of kidney damage
* **Urine culture**Identifying bacterial urinary tract infections
* **24-hour urine collection**An in-depth assessment of kidney function and metabolism
* **Urine protein**Screening for kidney disease and monitoring kidney function
* **Urine glucose**Monitoring glucose levels in diabetes
* **Ketones**Monitoring metabolism and ketosis
* **Urine creatinine**Assessing the kidney filtration rate
* **Toxicology screen**Detecting drugs and their metabolites

### Vitamins and trace elements
* **Vitamin D**Bone health, immunity and overall well-being
* **Vitamin B12**Nervous system health and blood formation
* **Folate (B9)**Blood formation, pregnancy and the nervous system
* **Magnesium**Neuromuscular function, sleep and blood pressure
* **Zinc**Immunity, skin and wound healing
* **Trace elements**Copper, selenium, manganese and other minerals

### Specialized
* **Allergy tests**Identifying the allergens that trigger reactions
* **Genetic tests**Analysis of genetic disease markers
* **Tumor markers**Screening and monitoring for certain cancers
* **Autoimmune panels**Antibodies associated with autoimmune diseases
* **Hemoglobin electrophoresis**Assessing hemoglobin fractions and possible hemoglobinopathies
* **Infectious disease panels**HIV, hepatitis B and C, syphilis, TORCH

These are just common examples — Wizey breaks down **any lab results and medical documents**, not
only those on this list.

before you upload

## For a *more complete breakdown*

Wizey reads the text on your medical documents. The clearer the data is, the more useful your final
report will be.

### The text must be readable

A photo or screenshot with no glare, cropped lines or heavy blur. What matters is that the names of
the markers and their values are clearly visible.

### Up to 15 files at once

Lab results, doctor's reports, discharge summaries and prescriptions can go into a single breakdown,
so Wizey can cross-reference the data.

### PDF, photo or screenshot

Files from your lab's patient portal, a photo of a paper form, or a screenshot all work, as long as
the medical text is visible.

first-pass summary, lets labs offer AI breakdowns as a service, and helps clinics automate their

* **Ketones**Monitoring metabolism and ketosis
* **Urine creatinine**Assessing the kidney filtration rate
* **Toxicology screen**Detecting drugs and their metabolites

### Vitamins and trace elements
* **Vitamin D**Bone health, immunity and overall well-being
* **Vitamin B12**Nervous system health and blood formation
* **Folate (B9)**Blood formation, pregnancy and the nervous system
* **Magnesium**Neuromuscular function, sleep and blood pressure
* **Zinc**Immunity, skin and wound healing
* **Trace elements**Copper, selenium, manganese and other minerals

### Specialized
* **Allergy tests**Identifying the allergens that trigger reactions
* **Genetic tests**Analysis of genetic disease markers
* **Tumor markers**Screening and monitoring for certain cancers
* **Autoimmune panels**Antibodies associated with autoimmune diseases
* **Hemoglobin electrophoresis**Assessing hemoglobin fractions and possible hemoglobinopathies
* **Infectious disease panels**HIV, hepatitis B and C, syphilis, TORCH

only those on this list.

Why bother

## You have the labs. You don't have *clarity*.

You drew blood. You got back twelve numbers, three red flags, and the feeling that everything is
fine and everything is wrong at the same time. That's the part we rewrite.

01 · Anxiety with no anchor

### The "normal range" isn't *your* range.

Lab reference intervals are built for an averaged population. Your age, sex, lifestyle, history —
none of that fits inside the bracket.

**Before:** "FERRITIN: 28 ng/mL · LOW"
**After:** "second drop in a quarter for you — recheck in 8 weeks"
02 · Charts with no meaning

### Is the line going up *good* or bad?

Most services hand you a stock-ticker chart. But health isn't a portfolio, and "trending up" isn't
always a win.

**Before:** 12-point chart, "↑ +34%"
**After:** "B12 has risen four months running — supplements are working, you can step down the dose"
03 · Advice with no owner

### Recommendations from *nowhere*.

An AI can fire off 14 tips in two seconds. But who decided they fit you? Who's going to do them? Who
checks they worked?

**Before:** "drink 2L of water and move more"
**After:** an 8-week plan with one task per week, and the owner is you
How it works

## Four steps from *PDF* to clarity.

Upload to understanding takes about fifteen minutes. You don't need to read the panel — that's our
job.

01 · INTAKE

#### Five minutes about *you*

Age, sex, goals, lifestyle. Enough for the report to talk to you, not to a "typical patient."

02 · UPLOAD

#### Drop the *PDF*

Any lab, any format. We pick out up to 340 markers. Nothing to type by hand.

03 · READ

#### A report in *sentences*

Not a table — a calm read. What matters, what waits, what to bring up with your doctor.

04 · PLAN

#### One thing *this week*

One task at a time. A vitamin, a recheck in 8 weeks, a consult. No checklist burnout.

Your report

## One report. One *link* for your doctor.

Every lab you've uploaded, in one place: the read, the prioritised plan, an overview of five body
systems, and the markers that need attention. Share a link with your doctor or download the PDF —
one click.

"I have three years of labs across three different labs. Used to live in a folder on my disk, things
would slip out of it. Now it's all in one place: I upload, and I stop tracking where the original
lives."

Frequently asked

## The *first* things people ask.

Is this a medical service?

No. Yasnost is an information and analytics service. We translate lab data into plain language, but
we don't diagnose and we don't prescribe.

Which labs do you support?

Invitro, Hemotest, LabQuest, Helix, CMD, KDL, Citilab and most private Russian labs. Public clinic
PDFs work too. TXT and CSV are accepted.

Where does my data live?

Encrypted on Russian servers, in line with Federal Law 152-FZ. We don't sell, share or train models
on your data. You can delete everything in one click.

How is the Health Score calculated?

It's a weighted sum across six components — biological age (25%), metabolism (20%), hormones,
inflammation, wearables (15% each) and nutrients (10%). Bio age uses the Levine PhenoAge formula on
9 markers. The same labs always produce the same score.

[Methodology →][13]How often should I retest?

Every 3 months is the sweet spot for tracking change. Pro plans include 4 uploads a year, Elite is
unlimited.

What happens if I cancel?

Your labs and PDFs stay. You move to the free plan and can export everything in one click. We don't
hold your data hostage.

Why bother

## You have the labs. You don't have *clarity*.

You drew blood. You got back twelve numbers, three red flags, and the feeling that everything is
fine and everything is wrong at the same time. That's the part we rewrite.

01 · Anxiety with no anchor

### The "normal range" isn't *your* range.

Lab reference intervals are built for an averaged population. Your age, sex, lifestyle, history —
none of that fits inside the bracket.

**Before:** "FERRITIN: 28 ng/mL · LOW"
**After:** "second drop in a quarter for you — recheck in 8 weeks"
02 · Charts with no meaning

### Is the line going up *good* or bad?

Most services hand you a stock-ticker chart. But health isn't a portfolio, and "trending up" isn't
always a win.

**Before:** 12-point chart, "↑ +34%"
**After:** "B12 has risen four months running — supplements are working, you can step down the dose"
03 · Advice with no owner

### Recommendations from *nowhere*.

An AI can fire off 14 tips in two seconds. But who decided they fit you? Who's going to do them? Who
checks they worked?

**Before:** "drink 2L of water and move more"
**After:** an 8-week plan with one task per week, and the owner is you
How it works

## Four steps from *PDF* to clarity.

Upload to understanding takes about fifteen minutes. You don't need to read the panel — that's our
job.

01 · INTAKE

#### Five minutes about *you*

Age, sex, goals, lifestyle. Enough for the report to talk to you, not to a "typical patient."

02 · UPLOAD

#### Drop the *PDF*

Any lab, any format. We pick out up to 340 markers. Nothing to type by hand.

03 · READ

#### A report in *sentences*

Not a table — a calm read. What matters, what waits, what to bring up with your doctor.

04 · PLAN

#### One thing *this week*

One task at a time. A vitamin, a recheck in 8 weeks, a consult. No checklist burnout.

Your report

## One report. One *link* for your doctor.

Every lab you've uploaded, in one place: the read, the prioritised plan, an overview of five body
systems, and the markers that need attention. Share a link with your doctor or download the PDF —
one click.

"I have three years of labs across three different labs. Used to live in a folder on my disk, things
would slip out of it. Now it's all in one place: I upload, and I stop tracking where the original
lives."

Frequently asked

## The *first* things people ask.

Is this a medical service?

No. Yasnost is an information and analytics service. We translate lab data into plain language, but
we don't diagnose and we don't prescribe.

Which labs do you support?

Invitro, Hemotest, LabQuest, Helix, CMD, KDL, Citilab and most private Russian labs. Public clinic
PDFs work too. TXT and CSV are accepted.

Where does my data live?

Encrypted on Russian servers, in line with Federal Law 152-FZ. We don't sell, share or train models
on your data. You can delete everything in one click.

How is the Health Score calculated?

It's a weighted sum across six components — biological age (25%), metabolism (20%), hormones,
inflammation, wearables (15% each) and nutrients (10%). Bio age uses the Levine PhenoAge formula on
9 markers. The same labs always produce the same score.

[Methodology →][13]How often should I retest?

Every 3 months is the sweet spot for tracking change. Pro plans include 4 uploads a year, Elite is
unlimited.

What happens if I cancel?

Your labs and PDFs stay. You move to the free plan and can export everything in one click. We don't
hold your data hostage.
